scope: Initialization and meaningful-field boundaries for the filter observer. Not complete referent coverage.
findings: vvp_net_fil_t initializes force_link_ to null and force_propagate_ to false; force_mask_ is a constructed vector, not raw allocation bytes.
vvp_wire_vec8 initializes needs_init_ and constructs its driven vector. vvp_vector8_t clears every logical element, including allocated wide-vector storage; force8_ starts empty.
A force link initializes port 2 (source) and port 3 (destination) before use. Only those meaningful endpoint fields are serialized; other port slots and object padding are not read.
Release clears selected mask bits; releasing every bit empties the mask. The old forced vector may remain allocated. Link storage persists after unlink, with a null source endpoint.
Filter propagation can call value callbacks and clear force_propagate_; the observer reads fields directly and never calls filtering or propagation methods.
Filter callback lists, force-link functor and source/destination fanout remain separate referents. Their pointer identity alone is not complete state coverage.
